theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Gaming/Esports platform requires a high-energy, dark mode look. Using Deep Void Black combined with the requested Electric Purple and Metallic Silver accents. Avoid pure black to reduce eye strain, favoring deep charcoal. Emphasizing cyber/esports aesthetic without generic purple/white AI gradients.

typography.rules: Never use Inter or Space Grotesk. Use Unbounded for Headings to provide a modern, wide gaming feel. Outfit for readable but technical body copy. Ensure APCA contrast ratio.

colors.rules: Avoid AI-slop purple gradients on white. Do not use Teal (#1B93A4). Use pure electric purple sparingly as an accent on dark backgrounds. Let silver/metallic tones act as secondary interactive colors.

marketing_pages.hero: Max overlay opacity bg-black/40. Use metallic_bg or esports_void as hero background with blending.

dashboard_and_marketplace.grid: MODE B: Control Room Grid (Dense, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4)
dashboard_and_marketplace.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-none or max rounded-md). 1px subtle metallic border. Cardless approach preferred for dense data.

components.rules: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the dark metallic theme. Ensure data-testid on all interactive elements. Avoid card component overuse; consider cardless rectangular layouts for complex data. Do not use border-radius larger than md to keep the 'metallic' sharp look.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Translate Y -2px, slight border color change to primary purple, increase box-shadow spread.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Framer motion fade in and subtle slide up (y: 10 to 0).
motion_and_interaction.micro_interactions: Pulse effect on 'Live' or 'Active' orders. Tracing beam effect on premium booster cards.

specific_pages.auth: Split screen layout. Left side: Abstract void image with branding. Right side: Login form (Email/Password + Google). Form must use standard metallic borders.
specific_pages.dashboard_home: Grid of games (Valorant, Rocket League). Top section: Active boosting offers (horizontal scroll or grid). Bottom section: Accounts for sale.
specific_pages.boosting_flow: Step-by-step or Bento layout. Select Mode -> Select Rank From/To -> Select Booster -> Payment/Credentials. Use visual rank icons or clean text with metallic styling.
specific_pages.chat: Real-time chat UI. Client messages on right (purple accent), Booster on left (slate accent). System messages centered. Fixed height container with overflow-y-auto.
specific_pages.admin_panel: Dense data table layout using Shadcn. Add/remove boosters via Firebase UID. List of conversations with moderation tools.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI primitives.
Ensure you are using .js/.jsx files, NOT .tsx files. Strip TypeScript from Shadcn components if necessary.
Configure Firebase Auth and Firestore. Structure collections: users, boosters, games, orders, accounts, messages.
Set up React Router for pages: /, /login, /dashboard, /games/:id, /boosters/:id, /order, /chat/:id, /admin.
Apply typography using Google Fonts Unbounded and Outfit. Ensure fonts are loaded in index.html.
Follow the theme_and_archetype strictly. No pure white backgrounds.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for testing.
Use the provided image URLs for the games and backgrounds.
Implement language as French (Français) for all static strings.
